name: Zabdiel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: More priests are named after them, with their chief men, and their overseer was Zabdiel, one of the great men. This is the register of the priesthood that served in the holy city.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
